summary: Audited 161 items in Condiments & Sauces. Coverage of Western and East-Asian staples is decent (ketchup, mustard, mayo, soy, hoisin, oyster, fish sauce, gochujang, doubanjiang, miso, teriyaki, BBQ, chimichurri, tahini, hummus, salsa). But the category is bloated with low-value flavor-variant children ('-spicy'/'-smoky'/'-regular' shells with no distinct data) while missing many globally common condiments: sambal oelek, sambal badjak, ssamjang, XO sauce, harissa, zhug/schug, chermoula, ajvar, mojo, romesco, salsa verde (Italian and Mexican), aioli, ranch/thousand-island/blue-cheese/caesar/green-goddess dressings, nuoc cham, ponzu is present but no kecap manis, doenjang, gochugaru-paste, chiu chow chili oil, chili crisp/crunch, calamansi, ume/umeboshi paste, wasabi, karashi, gochujang's soy cousin doenjang, tkemali, tonkatsu sauce, okonomiyaki sauce, unagi sauce, yuzu kosho, mole, tomatillo/green salsa, queso/cheese sauce, alfredo, vodka sauce, arrabbiata, tomato passata/sugo, gravy gaps (sausage/country/onion), nutritional-yeast-free gaps, pickled-jalapeno/giardiniera-style condiments, and many vinegars used as condiments (sherry, malt, champagne, distilled white, black/Chinkiang, coconut, ume plum). Several real data bugs exist: copy-pasted wrong aliases (peanut-butter / corn-syrup / enchilada strings leaking into horseradish, pico de gallo, etc.), the 'plum-duck-sauce' item is mislabeled 'plum', and a confused plum/duck-sauce parent web. Recommend pruning redundant variant shells, fixing leaked aliases, and adding the global condiments below (liberal/global inclusion).
issues: Massive low-value '-spicy'/'-smoky'/'-regular'/'-hot' variant inflation: e.g. barbecue-sauce-smoky, barbecue-sauce-spicy, brown-sauce-smoky, brown-sauce-spicy, chimichurri-smoky, chimichurri-spicy, ketchup-regular, ketchup-spicy, teriyaki-sauce-regular, teriyaki-sauce-spicy, worcestershire-sauce-regular/-spicy, oyster-sauce-regular, tamarind-paste-regular, sweet-and-sour-sauce-spicy, peanut-sauce-spicy, guacamole-spicy, hummus-spicy, salsa-hot, chili-sauce-hot, chili-sauce-spicy, cocktail-sauce-spicy, duck-sauce-spicy, enchilada-sauce-hot, pickle-relish-spicy, pickled-ginger-spicy, plum-sauce-spicy, tartar-sauce-spicy. These are heat/flavor adjectives on a base item, not distinct pantry SKUs; most carry empty aliases and add no shelf-life signal. Consider collapsing into the parent (a 'spiciness' facet) rather than separate catalog items.

Wrong/leaked aliases from copy-paste (clear data bugs): creamy-horseradish has alias 'creamy peanut butter'; crunchy-chocolate-hazelnut-spread has alias 'crunchy peanut butter'; corn-pico-de-gallo has aliases 'light corn syrup','light-colored corn syrup','white corn syrup'; green-chimichurri has alias 'green enchilada sauce'; red-chimichurri has alias 'red enchilada sauce'; white-balsamic-vinegar has alias 'white gravy'; sweet-adobo-sauce has alias 'sweet relish'; thai-chili-sauce has alias 'thai peanut sauce'.

plum-duck-sauce: id is 'plum-duck-sauce' but name is just 'plum' and parent is duck-sauce — confusing. The actual fruit 'plum' should not live here; this looks like a duplicate/garbled record. Also plum-sauce lists parent 'plum' (a produce id) AND duck-sauce lists parent 'plum' — circular/garbled plum web.

gochujang inherits generic aliases 'sambal','chile paste','chili pastes','chilli paste' from chili-paste — these are wrong for gochujang (sambal is a different Indonesian product) and will cause mismatches.
chili-paste itself lists 'sambal' as an alias, conflating a generic chili paste with the specific Indonesian sambal family.

Storage inconsistency among variants of the SAME product: enchilada-sauce is Pantry but enchilada-sauce-hot is Refrigerated (mild/medium are Pantry); barbecue-sauce is Refrigerated while original-barbecue-sauce (child) is Refrigerated but bottled BBQ is shelf-stable until opened; worcestershire-sauce is Pantry but worcestershire-sauce-regular child is Refrigerated. Storage should be consistent within a product family.
vegetarian-black-bean-sauce has name 'vegetarian' (truncated); oyster-sauce-regular name fine but redundant with parent.

mustard base item carries an enormous alias dump that mixes prepared mustard, mustard powder, AND mustard SEEDS ('black mustard seed','white mustard seed','yellow mustard seed') — seeds belong in Spices & Herbs, not as aliases of the condiment. 'remoulades' is also wrongly aliased onto mustard.

syrup and sauce and paste are extremely generic catch-all base items (syrup aliases include vanilla/strawberry/raspberry/cane/honey syrups spanning Baking and Beverages). 'syrup' arguably belongs in Baking & Sweeteners, not Condiments & Sauces.

bouillon family (beef/chicken/fish/lamb/mushroom/vegetable bouillon, demi-glace) is arguably its own 'stocks & broths' concept rather than a condiment; beef-bouillon alias list duplicates the parent bouillon aliases verbatim.
orange-blossom-water and rose-water are flavorings/baking aromatics, not really condiments/sauces — likely miscategorized.
tartar-sauce parent includes 'mayonnaise' (good) but remoulade has no parent despite being a mayonnaise-based sauce; aioli is missing entirely.
tajin is categorized here but is a seasoning blend (Spices & Herbs) — borderline; chili-lime seasoning is more spice than sauce.

Missing freshness 'Pantry' on several shelf-stable-until-opened bottled sauces stored as Refrigerated (e.g. hoisin, oyster, teriyaki, sriracha) — fine if intended as after-opening, but inconsistent with fish-sauce/soy-sauce which keep a Pantry window.
redundancies: ketchup-regular is just ketchup with no distinguishing data; collapse
regular variant identical to base oyster sauce
regular variant identical to base, shares all aliases
classic chimichurri == base chimichurri; classic-chimichurri also overlaps green-chimichurri
green chimichurri is the standard/default chimichurri; both green and classic duplicate the base
beef-bouillon copies the parent bouillon alias list verbatim (broth/stock cube strings); aliases at minimum are redundant
chili-sauce-hot and chili-sauce-spicy are duplicate heat variants of the same base
two near-identical heat-variant shells of chili-sauce
spicy variant duplicates base aliases, no distinct data
corn-pico-de-gallo carries corn-syrup aliases (data bug) and is a niche variant of pico de gallo
smoky/spicy adobo variants are heat shells of adobo-sauce; chipotle-adobo-sauce is the meaningful one
plum-duck-sauce (name 'plum') is a garbled duplicate of duck-sauce

Remove alias 'green enchilada sauce' (wrong product).
Remove alias 'red enchilada sauce' (wrong product).
Remove wrong aliases 'white gravy', plus 'aceto balsamico','balsamic','balsamic vinegars' (those are dark balsamic); add 'white balsamic'.
Remove alias 'sweet relish' (wrong product).
Remove alias 'thai peanut sauce' (peanut sauce is a distinct product); keep thai chili descriptors.
Fix name 'plum' -> rename to 'plum duck sauce' or merge into duck-sauce; ensure it does not collide with the produce 'plum'.
Fix truncated name 'vegetarian' -> 'vegetarian black bean sauce'.
Remove inherited generic aliases 'sambal','chile paste','chili pastes','chilli paste'; keep gochujang-specific names. Sambal is a different product.
Remove alias 'sambal' (sambal is a distinct Indonesian item; will be added separately).

Move mustard SEED aliases ('black/white/yellow mustard seed') out to Spices & Herbs; remove 'remoulades' alias (remoulade is its own item); trim the over-broad dump now that specific mustard children (dijon, yellow, english, whole-grain, brown, honey) exist.
Set defaultStorage to 'Pantry' to match enchilada-sauce / mild / medium (bottled enchilada sauce is shelf-stable until opened).
Set defaultStorage to 'Pantry' to match base worcestershire-sauce (it is shelf-stable).
Remove duplicated parent-bouillon aliases ('bouillon cubes','broth cube', etc.); keep only beef-specific aliases.

Good parents; consider parenting remoulade under mayonnaise too for consistency.
Reconsider category: 'syrup' (with cane/vanilla/strawberry aliases) is a sweetener; likely belongs in Baking & Sweeteners, not Condiments & Sauces.
